page.overview:
What is Lurantis?

Lurantis is a plant-like Pokémon with insectoid traits. Its body has shades of pink with white accents. It has light red eyes and two green antennae with a small green lump between them. There are four extensions to the top half of its head: two on the top with red tips that resemble ears, and one on each side with white tips that resemble stylized hair. Its forearms resembles a mantis's arm and are each tipped with a green claw.

Lurantis are able to defeat their enemies with their elegant appearance and pleasant-smelling aroma. Due to their beautiful moves and bright coloration, Lurantis are said to be the most beautiful of all Grass-type Pokémon. Also, they dislike lazy Trainers, preferring those who would look after them with care. With enough care from its Trainer, a Lurantis will display vivid colors.

Lurantis feeds on small bird Pokémon and their eggs, which it lures to itself by imitating a bug Pokémon or a flower, before attacking any unsuspecting victims.

Lurantis can use their sickle-shaped petals to fire devastating energy beams by drawing sunlight, which have enough strength to slice through thick metal plates.
